QuestInfo.name: [White Heaven] Sorry About the Beating : Thursday
QuestInfo.0: You need to get the weather spirits to return to Karula's ship. Go see Karula aboard her ship.
QuestInfo.1: Karula has a magic LP that should do the trick. Just put it in the Phonograph as Karula explained, and remember that different LPs must be played on different days.
QuestInfo.2: You used the LP to bring back the spirits. Good thing you didn't have to convince them yourself.
